newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Alternative estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Alternative estimates cut.

text.p: -- Everen Securities Inc said it lowered its earnings estimates for Alternative Resources Inc due to an expected decline in the gross margins of the staffing company.

-- Earnings estimates for 1997 were trimmed to $0.95 a share from $1.03 and for 1998 to $1.18 from $1.27. These results compare with estimated 1996 earnings of $0.82 a share which are expected to be reported on January 22, Everen said in a report.
-- Shares of Alternative Resources were trading off 3/8 at 14-7/8.
